title: Automated E. coli transformation (BOTany4-Shock&Go) of Golden Gate assemblies with blue/white screening

containers.name: parts_plate
containers.description: MoClo part DNA: col 1 backbone, col 2 promoter, col 3 CDS, col 4 terminator; rows A-H = assemblies 1-8

containers.name: ligase_tube
containers.description: T4 DNA ligase, Thermo EL0012 5 U/uL

containers.name: gg_plate
containers.description: Golden Gate reactions on the on-deck thermocycler, A1:H1

containers.name: cells_tube
containers.description: Thawed TOP10F' competent cells in 85 mM CaCl2/15% glycerol, kept cold

containers.name: transform_plate
containers.description: Transformation reactions on the on-deck thermocycler, A1:H1

initial_contents.reagent: MoClo part plasmids (backbone, promoter, CDS, terminator), approx. 20-40 fmol/uL

steps.source_quote: 6 µL of Master Mix containing 1 µL 10 mM ATP (Thermo Fisher Scientific, MA, USA; R0441)
steps.note: 1 uL per reaction scaled to 10 reactions (8 + overage)

steps.source_quote: 0.5 µL FastDigest type IIS restriction enzyme
steps.note: Eco31I chosen for L1 assemblies; scaled to 10 reactions

steps.source_quote: 0.5 µL T4 DNA ligase (either brand mentioned above)
combined with 6 µL of Master Mix
1 µL each of the MoClo parts (backbone, promoter, CDS, and terminator)
1 µL each of the MoClo parts (backbone, promoter, CDS, and terminator)
1 µL each of the MoClo parts (backbone, promoter, CDS, and terminator)
1 µL each of the MoClo parts (backbone, promoter, CDS, and terminator)

steps.action: Seal gg_plate and run on thermocycler: 30 cycles of 37 °C 3 min / 22 °C 4 min (Thermo T4 ligase); then 37 °C 5 min and 65 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C
steps.source_quote: Efficient ligation was obtained with T4 DNA ligases from Thermo Fisher Scientific (MA, USA; 5 U/µL; EL0012) at 22°C
steps.note: Cycling program from Thermo FastDigest Eco31I manual (37 °C digestion, 65 °C 5 min inactivation) and standard Golden Gate practice; not given in paper

steps.action: Thaw competent cell aliquots on ice and pool into cells_tube (about 400+ uL); chill transform_plate on the on-deck thermocycler at 4 °C
steps.source_quote: All further steps were performed on ice or using equipment and reagents chilled to 4°C.
Aliquots (50 to 100 µL) were dispensed into pre-chilled sterile 1.5-mL tubes
steps.note: 50 uL cells per transformation (assumed); PCR-plate format on thermocycler
3 uL of unpurified reaction (assumed within 2-5 uL); gentle post-dispense mix

steps.action: Seal transform_plate; on-deck thermocycler: 4 °C 20 min, 42 °C 45 s heat shock, 4 °C 2 min
steps.note: Heat-shock parameters not stated in paper; SM4 deferred. Based on Zymo FAQ (ice 5-10 min, 42 °C 45 s) and standard practice
200 uL used to stay within plate well capacity (Zymo FAQ suggests 450 uL for 50 uL cells)

steps.action: Incubate transform_plate 60 min at 37 °C on the on-deck thermocycler (outgrowth)
steps.note: 1 h on-deck outgrowth per paper Results text/recovered details; shaking not available

steps.action: For each of the 8 transformations, spread 10 µL X-gal (20 mg/mL in DMSO) and 30 µL IPTG (100 mM in water) onto a pre-warmed 60 mm low-salt LB agar plate with 50 µg/mL carbenicillin, then pipette 50 µL of the recovered culture from transform_plate (A1:H1) and spread it on the plate
steps.source_quote: 50 µL E. coli cell cultures were plated on 60 mm plates containing low salt LB agar supplemented with proper antibiotics (50 µg/mL carbenicillin and spectinomycin for MoClo L1 and LM constructs, respectively).
steps.note: Carbenicillin used for L1 constructs; plates pre-warmed (assumed)

steps.action: Incubate plates overnight at 37 °C, then count blue and white colonies per plate
steps.source_quote: Plates were incubated overnight at 37°C to allow colony formation.

assumptions: Layout: 8 assemblies in rows A-H; parts_plate col 1 backbone, col 2 promoter, col 3 CDS, col 4 terminator; gg_plate and transform_plate wells A1:H1.
Identity of the 8 assemblies is not specified; any 8 Plant MoClo L1 constructs; Eco31I (BsaI) and Thermo T4 ligase at 22 °C chosen.
Part DNA concentration about 20-40 fmol/uL (about 50-100 ng) assumed (standard practice); parts plate volume 10 uL per well assumed.
Master mix prepared for 10 reactions (8 + overage); ATP, buffer, enzyme, ligase and water stocks assumed in separate 1.5 mL tubes.

Golden Gate cycling (30 x 37 °C 3 min/22 °C 4 min, then 37 °C 5 min, 65 °C 5 min) assumed from the Thermo FastDigest Eco31I manual (37 °C, 65 °C 5 min inactivation) and standard practice (Engler et al.).
Competent cells: 50 uL per transformation, thawed on ice/cold block; cells_tube volume 500 uL assumed.
3 uL of unpurified Golden Gate reaction added to cells (assumed; paper does not state).
Heat shock 4 °C 20 min, 42 °C 45 s, 4 °C 2 min assumed (Supplementary Method S4 not available; Zymo Mix&Go FAQ and standard practice).

Recovery in 200 uL SOC at 37 °C for 60 min on-deck without shaking; 200 uL used instead of 450 uL (Zymo FAQ) to fit the 360 uL plate well limit. The 1 h outgrowth comes from the recovered paper details.
Plating, X-gal/IPTG spreading and colony counting are manual; plates pre-warmed to 37 °C (assumed). Plate pipetting is shown as manual since agar plates are not an allowed container kind.
The Mix&Go! (Zymo) comparison arm is not described in the paper and is not included.
Competent cell preparation (s4.4) is treated as already done; cells are assumed ready as frozen aliquots.
